rationale: The round 2 exchange adds useful quantification and narrows the debate to closure-equivalent savings, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labour and the state still reject closures and forced redundancies, while management, ownership, and investors still insist on structurally equivalent savings that may require them. Positions have hardened into a clearer but still negotiable impasse, so another round could still test whether a quantified non-closure package exists.
